Agent Name: NumericalAlgorithms_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: They implemented the wrong convergence criterion. Instead of checking when x_n and x_{n+1} are equal after rounding to four decimal places (which occurs at n=2: x2 ≈ -4.9361054 and x3 ≈ -4.9361048 both round to -4.9361), they used |x_{n+1} − x_n| < 1e-4 as the stopping condition and reported n=3. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect smallest n.
